draft.subject: Getting your first project going in Wrenfield
draft.body:
Hi Maya,

Thanks for the kind words about onboarding — good to hear it felt smooth. And to confirm what Tariq mentioned: seats can be added any time from Account Settings.

I also saw an invite go out to a teammate, which is a great start. The next step that usually makes everything click is the first project — in Wrenfield, projects are the main organizing unit, and tasks live inside them.

If it's useful, send me a rough list of what your team is working on this week and I'll help you shape it into that first project.

Best,
Priya
